_comment: Provider-literal ratchet (G1). Per-file occurrence count of provider-ID references in core. May only go DOWN. Regenerate: node scripts/check-provider-literal-ratchet.mjs --write. Every counted file must have an `allowlist` entry (count, reason, owner, diesAt); the entries are authored by hand and survive --write. Delete this file and the guard when empty.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/providers..reason: demo fixtures: the demo server's static provider roster.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/world.ts.reason: demo fixtures: the demo world's default provider.

apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.reason: legacy persisted data: pre-v3 codex timelines recorded the native turn id with no checkpoint; the fallback reads them.
apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.diesAt: legacy-tool-item-backfill migration (stamps the checkpoint onto old rows)

packages/config/src/hyperfide-app-manage.reason: BUNDLED_PROVIDER_IDS: `customModelProviderIdSchema` (live `customModels` config) accepts only a bundled id or an `acp-*` id, so a third-party provider cannot carry custom models today.
packages/config/src/hyperfide-app-manage.diesAt: when customModels accepts any registered provider id

packages/scripts/src/commands/archive-co.reason: ops script for codex temp sessions: names the `codex` executable, not a provider branch.

packages/scripts/src/lib/seed-perf-fixtu.reason: perf fixture generator: seeds threads for two providers so the timeline benchmark covers both shapes.

apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.reason: session import (hyperfide-v22 7.21): the on-disk transcript formats it can read are named after the tools that wrote them; the names select a parser, not a provider.
apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.diesAt: hyperfide-v22 7.23: import source kinds and fleet runner kinds move behind registries, after which these entries are deleted
